fusions.name: Chop and Bear Away
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. For 2 seconds after, you move 12% faster.

fusions.name: Bring Down the Rigging
fusions.desc: Cuts the rigging down across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 8 damage to everything in it with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Cut the Cable
fusions.desc: Frees you from up to 2 conditions that hold or stun you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Boarder's Hatchet
fusions.desc: Conjures a boarding hatchet. Your weapon damage rises by 10% and you move 4% faster, and every strike with it makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
